# Programs

[![APEX Accelerator](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/APEX-logo-1.png)

#### APEX Accelerator (APEX Accelerator)

APEX Accelerator procurement technical assistance center provides technical expertise to South Dakota businesses interested in bidding on and receiving federal, state and local government contracts.  
  
This procurement technical assistance center is funded in part through a cooperative agreement with the Department of Defense.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/procurement-technical-assistance-center/)

[![Enterprise Institute](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/Enterprise-Logo-Color.jpg)

#### Enterprise Institute (SDEI)

The Enterprise Institute is a private, non-profit corporation that provides customized business development and commercialization services to entrepreneurs, inventors, and start-up companies in South Dakota.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/enterprise-institute/)

[![International Trade Center](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/sbdc-logo-2025.jpg)

#### International Trade Center (ITC)

The International Trade Center (ITC) is part of the South Dakota Small Business Development Center serving as a source of management assistance to small businesses considering exporting, new to exporting, or those with exporting finance packaging needs.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/international-trade-center/)

[![Manufacturing & Technology Solutions](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/MTS_logo_2c.jpg)

#### Manufacturing & Technology Solutions (MTS)

Manufacturing & Technology Solutions (MTS) is a South Dakota based resource for South Dakota's manufacturers looking to improve profitability through continuous improvement and innovation.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/manufacturing-technology-solutions/)

[![Small Business Development Center](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/sbdc-logo-2025.jpg)

#### Small Business Development Center (SBDC)

The South Dakota Small Business Development Center (SBDC) helps new entrepreneurs realize their dream of business ownership and assists existing businesses in their efforts to remain competitive.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/small-business-development-center/)

[![Small Business Innovation Research](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/USD-Logo.jpg)

#### Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR)

We help qualified small businesses propose innovative ideas that meet research and development needs of the federal government with the potential for commercialization.

](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/small-business-innovation-research/)

## Start, grow and improve your business in South Dakota. We can help.

The South Dakota Small Business Development Center is a part of a nationwide network to help small businesses from start up to growth. They offer consulting services including start up counseling, business planning, market research, marketing, small business financing programs, financing analysis, cash flow and management, business expansion and small business information.

Consulting services are professional, confidential, and at no cost to small businesses. The mission of the South Dakota Small Business Development center is to be an advisor for South Dakota businesses to start or grow by assisting with business planning, operation improvement, and product or market development. 

The SDSBDC is fully accredited and equipped to help the small businesses of South Dakota. Their offices can be located in Sioux Falls, Rapid City, Aberdeen, Watertown, Pierre, and Yankton, SD.

[Visit Our Website  
](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/small-business-development-center/)

  

## KNOWN FOR EXCELLENCE

With qualities like small class sizes, specialized programs and incredible student opportunities, USD is not your typical university. What makes us unique is what makes your education exceptional.

## Recent News

[More News Like This](https://www.usd.edu/The-South-Dakotan/News-Listing)

## Gain Real-World Experience

Coyote Business Consulting Group is a student-centered initiative at the USD Beacom School of Business designed to help businesses stay competitive in the state of South Dakota and throughout the region. The program enables student-teams, with the guidance of faculty advisors, to help businesses solve a critical problem for their organization.

Coyote Business Consulting Group is intended to be mutually beneficial for both the students and the businesses. The consulting service will be offered at no charge to businesses and students will have the opportunity to receive academic credit, financial support and real-world experience. Available to all businesses, but a special emphasis is placed on small businesses, as they are the backbone of our economy.

[Learn More](https://www.usd.edu/Academics/Colleges-and-Schools/beacom-school-of-business/Coyote-Business-Consulting "Coyote Business Consulting Page")

# Resources

#### [Small Business Development Center](https://sdbusinesshelp.com/)

The South Dakota Small Business Development Center serves as an advisor to new or growing South Dakota businesses by assisting with business planning, operational improvement, and product or market development.

#### [West River Business Service Center](https://wrbsc.com/)

West River Business Service Center serves as a one-stop resource center for growing western South Dakota businesses.

#### [Rushmore Region Alliance](https://www.rushmoreregion.com/)

The Rushmore Region Alliance provides consulting, marketing, and other services to support the growth and success of new and existing businesses in western South Dakota, as well as to businesses relocating to the region.

#### [Governor’s Office Economic Development](https://sdgoed.com/)

The South Dakota’s Governor’s Office of Economic Development offers information and resources to create jobs and support companies throughout the state.

#### [U.S. Small Business Administration](https://www.sba.gov/)

The U.S. Small Business Administration provides counseling, loans, and support in receiving federal government contracts to small businesses across the country.

#### [SDCEO Women’s Business Center](https://www.bhsu.edu/sdceo/)

The SDCEO Women’s Business Center offers free business advising, professional development resources, and business training to empower women entrepreneurs and intrapreneurs.

#### [Black Hills Council of Local Governments](https://www.blackhillscouncil.com/)

The Black Hills Council assists communities and organizations that are looking to finance infrastructure and community facilities projects by identifying potential grant and loan funding sources, application preparation, and grant and loan administration.

#### [First District Association of Local Governments](https://association.1stdistrict.org/)

First District Association of Local Governments assists communities and organizations that are looking to finance infrastructure and community facilities projects by identifying potential grant and loan funding sources, application preparation, and grant and loan administration.
